description: This file implements a network interface monitoring service for Ethernet links, including thread management, event subscription handling, and callback registration for link status changes, with server initialization and signal handling.

methods.name: ethsw_thread_main
methods.description: Thread function that monitors Ethernet link status by executing system commands and publishes events on status change.

methods.name: GWP_RegisterEthWan_Callback
methods.description: Registers callback functions for Ethernet WAN link up/down events.

methods.name: sig_handler
methods.description: Handles termination signals to cleanly shut down the server.

methods.name: GWP_EthWanLinkDown_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked when Ethernet link goes down, publishes event.

methods.name: GWP_EthWanLinkUp_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked when Ethernet link goes up, publishes event.

methods.name: subs_event_cb
methods.description: Handles subscription requests for Ethernet link events, initializes hardware if needed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes server, registers callbacks, starts monitoring thread, and handles signals.
